units.source_text: 这是一座充满威严、忧郁而精致的建筑物。

en.t: This was a building filled with dignity, melancholy, and refinement.

units.source_text: 是一座处处留下了剥落的金箔的奢侈的尸体似的建筑物。

en.t: It was a building like a luxurious corpse, with traces of peeling gold leaf left everywhere.

units.source_text: 这座永恒澄明地浮现着的金阁，在既近又远、既亲又疏的不可思议的距离上出现了。

en.t: This Golden Pavilion, emerging with eternal clarity, appeared at a strange distance that was both near and far, both intimate and remote.
